lead_headline: Restaurant tracker breaks three-day silence with zero new leads—licensing freeze enters day 29 as Memorial Day hangover persists across all tracking systems

restaurant.blurb: Day four of detection drought—zero new leads Thursday as post-holiday silence stretches into fourth consecutive day. Active pipeline frozen at 188 (106 openings, 82 closures).

liquor.blurb: Day 29 of absolute regulatory silence—Colorado's liquor licensing apparatus sustains unprecedented freeze with zero applications, zero status changes, zero administrative movement since April 30. The May blackout enters final 48 hours as all 12,396 tracked licenses remain locked in month-long bureaucratic paralysis. Memorial Day week closes with no disruption to the disruption—state officials maintain radio silence on restoration timeline while invisible application backlog accumulates. The licensing system's complete suspension extends deeper into record territory as month-end approaches with no thaw signals detected.

reputation.blurb: 3 mentions yesterday—pickup velocity remains suppressed at single-digit levels for fourth straight day. Weekly total climbs to 32 across 8 sources, down 54% from prior week's 69 as Memorial Day hangover depresses citation flow. Instagram dominates with 11 mentions (34%), Facebook contributes 6, Reddit and Denver Post add 5 and 4 respectively. Google News RSS exclusively drives all discovery (100% of weekly volume). The sharp week-over-week collapse confirms extended post-holiday lethargy in media pickup patterns, though monthly tracking holds elevated at 208 total mentions as May enters final days.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled)—Memorial Day flatline extends to fourth consecutive day of zero movement. MTD holds at +23 (+0.8/day), 90-day net stands at +135. Seven-day window shows net +2 (4 new, 2 canceled) as sustained post-surge drought deepens. May's pattern crystallizes: mid-month burst (May 12-15) delivered the month's gains, followed by 14-day near-blackout through holiday and beyond. Recent fortnight shows dramatic collapse from prior period's +6 net, confirming momentum evaporation. YTD pace of +1.2/day continues outpacing anemic MTD rate as daily flow settles into zero-movement equilibrium through month's close.
